Item Class: Tablet
Rarity: Rare
Cosmic Apex
Irradiated Tablet
--------
Item Level: 82
--------
{ Implicit Modifier }
Adds Irradiated to a Map
10 uses remaining
--------
{ Prefix Modifier "Bountiful" (Tier: 1) }
34(25-35)% increased Gold found in Map
{ Prefix Modifier "Treasurer's" (Tier: 1) }
Map contains 2(2-3) additional Rare Chests
{ Suffix Modifier "of Shrines" (Tier: 1) }
Map has 75(70-100)% increased chance to contain Shrines
{ Suffix Modifier "of Strongboxes" (Tier: 1) }
Map has 94(70-100)% increased chance to contain Strongboxes
--------
Can be used in a personal Map Device to add modifiers to a Map.
